notes.title: 🦊 Demo version Update! 🐸
notes.content:
[h3]Demo version updated[/h3]

We have fixed some problems that were reported to us after the release of the demo version.
Please update and play the latest version!

- Fixed a problem with the screen not showing after start-up the game in several MacOS environments.
- Fixes for the behaviour problems that were occurring on devices in some language regions.


[h3]Demo version release period extended[/h3]

The demo was scheduled to be open until 12 May but will be extended until 19 May (JST).
You will not be able to play it after the end of the public access period, so we hope you will give it a try while you still can!

Thank you.

notes.title: "Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino" 's demo is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42723363/75ef6708f10f44b7e0cc234df8ef1e47ac323f4a.png[/img]

"Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino" 's demo is now available in time for [url=https://www.ludonarracon.com/]LudoNarraCon[/url] 2023!
It will be available until at least May 11(PDT). 


We will also be streaming the process of the environment concept art for the actual game during this event, so please check back!
After playing the demo, please don't forget to add it to your Wishlist!
